answer: Sign in and open My Complaints or your citizen dashboard. Select your complaint to see its status, assignment and timeline. To check a specific complaint here, send its ID in complaint_id or write "status of complaint #123".

submitted: received; under_review: being assessed; assigned: routed to a department or officer; in_progress: work underway; verification_pending: staff submitted a resolution for review; resolved: closed by the recorded citizen/quorum or staff-review outcome; reopened: further work is needed. Check the incident outcome and timeline instead of assuming every reporter approved.

answer: When staff submit a resolution, a timed verification round begins. Check the incident's deadline and required approval count. Each reporter can respond once during the window with resolved=true to approve or resolved=false with feedback to reject. Quorum may close the incident; silence is not approval. A valid rejection reopens it. After expiry staff must record an evidence review before closing without quorum.

Admins route complaints to departments and active officers. Authorities work within their department or explicit assignments and can assign a compatible officer. Only admins transfer complaints between departments. Staff submit resolution evidence for citizen verification.
